span.p: What do you want the lab to run?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Budget under ~$150,
using hardware you
already own or can
find used?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Need Windows endpoints,
NSM, and a honeynet
running concurrently?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Need long PCAP/log
retention, or a
Windows domain
experiment (Part 11)?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Expect to run: one SIEM
+ 1-2 lightweight endpoints.
No full honeynet, no NSM sensor.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Expect to run: SIEM +
Linux/Windows endpoints +
Zeek/Suricata + small honeynet.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Expect to run: everything
Tier 2 runs, plus a physically
separate honeynet host and
months of retention.
